title: Gallery kinds and filters
description: Corner kind icon on gallery cards that are more than a plain image (video, 3D scene), driven by one ASSET_KINDS table. The six filter chips and the second toolbar row become a FILTER button with a Reuse-Prompt-style panel (types, Favourites/Previews, sort) and a heat dot when filtered; gallery controls move into the project bar, dropping the assets/size readout when narrow.
